integrity_statement: Analytic proof of the claimed asymptotic is supplied; 52 exact-rational finite tests only cross-check moment identities, not infinite tail laws. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only real, finite-dimensional, nonzero positive-semidefinite inputs and Gaussian/spherical Kronecker probe factors are covered.
The logarithmic tail law is for fixed numbers of modes, fixed mode dimensions, and fixed numbers of iid samples; no dimension-uniform prefactor or finite-threshold bound follows.
The equality case for the one-factor exponential-moment threshold is not classified; an explicit product-state radius may be computationally difficult.
General Gaussian-chaos and large-deviation methods are prior art, and independent publication-priority assessment has not been performed.
title: Radial conditioning and exact tail transitions for Kronecker Gaussian trace estimators
